model.interpretation: A finite box of cards, each bearing an X and Y label, drawn uniformly; authored joint counts define the exact finite distribution. No sampling/estimation, causal inference or real data claim.
model.admission: 2–4 rows and 2–4 columns, rectangular integer arrays; each count0–999, at least one positive count. Text parser accepts one row per line and whitespace-separated canonical unsigned decimal cells, permits outer whitespace/CRLF, rejects internal blank lines, signs/fractions/exponents/booleans/nonfinite/ragged/oversized text. Maximum512 UTF-16 code units.
model.arithmetic: Counts/totals/fraction numerators and denominators remain exact safe integers. Base2 logarithms and entropy/MI values are binary64 approximations; display rounding is separate. No tolerance decides independence.
model.observations: Copied immutable complete matrix, row/column totals and distributions, every joint probability and independent-product probability, both families of conditional distributions and entropies, all joint entropy and weighted MI cell contributions, H(X),H(Y),H(X,Y),H(Y|X),H(X|Y),I(X;Y). Exact independence checks n_ij*N = row_i*col_j for every cell, with retained differing cross-products.
model.zero: A zero-marginal conditional is explicitly undefined/null with zero aggregate weight. A zero-probability entropy/MI summand is zero by convention. It is never evaluated as 0*log2(0). Zero-cell surprisal/pointwise information is not a finite zero and is not fabricated; nullable excluded-cell metadata explains it. Every positive cell has positive marginals.
model.interpretationLimits: MI is nonnegative and symmetric but conditional entropies need not match. A particular conditioned distribution can have more entropy than the marginal; only the average is bounded. Individual weighted MI contributions can be negative. Exact independence describes this authored table; a sampled zero count would not prove a population impossibility. No sign/direction/causation/learning-grade/compressor-size claim.
model.purity: Reads do not mutate caller arrays. Outputs are detached, nested frozen snapshots. Invalid input refuses before a usable observation.
